module_title: Establishment and Primary Functions of the RBI
introduction: At this beginner level, we will look at the historical foundation of the RBI and memorize its core responsibilities as the central bank of India. The RBI acts as the financial nerve center of the country.

core_concepts.title: Establishment
core_concepts.description: The RBI was established on 'April 1, 1935', under the RBI Act of 1934, based on the recommendations of the 'Hilton Young Commission' (Royal Commission on Indian Currency and Finance). Initially headquartered in Calcutta, it was permanently moved to Mumbai in 1937.

core_concepts.title: Nationalization
core_concepts.description: The RBI started as a privately owned bank. Post-independence, it was nationalized on 'January 1, 1949', bringing it completely under government ownership.

core_concepts.title: Issuer of Currency
core_concepts.description: The RBI has the sole monopoly to issue all currency notes in India, EXCEPT the One Rupee note. The One Rupee note and all coins are minted by the Government of India (Ministry of Finance).

core_concepts.title: Banker to the Government and Banks
core_concepts.description: 1. Banker to Government: It manages the accounts of the Central and State governments and provides them with short-term loans called Ways and Means Advances (WMA). 2. Banker's Bank: All commercial banks must keep a portion of their reserves with the RBI, and the RBI lends to them in times of need (Lender of Last Resort).

important_entities.name: Signatures on Currency
important_entities.significance: All currency notes (₹10, ₹20, ₹100, ₹500, etc.) bear the signature of the 'Governor of the RBI'. However, the ₹1 note bears the signature of the 'Finance Secretary of India'. This is a massive favorite in trivia and competitive exams.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Historically, the RBI's accounting year was from July to June. However, this was changed recently. Now, the RBI's accounting year exactly matches the Government of India's financial year: 'April 1 to March 31'.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Bank of Issue (Currency), Banker to Government, Banker's Bank, and Balancer of Forex (Manages Foreign Exchange Reserves).

exam_strategy_tips: Hilton Young Commission = Origin of RBI. Memorize this exact name. It is the most frequently asked historical question regarding the RBI.
